blocks.html: Roxaco-Vanguard Hotel Corporation (RVHC) in association with Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), officially opens its third Go Hotels branch at Cubao: Quezon City’s most recognized commercial district and major hub for grand events. Business and leisure travelers may now enjoy amenities and experience quality service accommodation for as low as PHP 588.00 up to PHP3,088+VAT per room when booking through Go Hotels official website Situated near the intersection of two major highways: Aurora Boulevard and EDSA, Go Hotels Cubao - Quezon City is just few minutes away from Araneta Center. A mixed-use complex that houses a wide variety of shopping, leisure, entertainment, corporate, residential and hotel selection. The hotel is accessible to major public transport which makes it convenient for the city dwellers and transients. Go Hotels Cubao - Quezon City is the third out of five projects of Roxaco-Vanguard Hotel Corporation. The two remaining branches, Timog - Quezon City and Ermita - Manila will be opening in the second quarter of 2017. Go Hotels Cubao - Quezon City offers a total of 159 rooms with twin and queen rooms. The hotel also offers rooms for people with special needs, giving them enough space to mobility. All rooms are equipped with safety and security features, hot and cold showers, high quality beds; 100% cotton sheets and duvet covers complete with non-allergenic pillows, 32 inch LED cable TV, and individually controlled air conditioning units. The Roxaco Vanguard Hotel Corporation is a joint venture of Roxaco Land Corporation and Vanguard Hotels Select (Phil) Pte. Ltd. Vanguard Hotels, based in Singapore with its ROHQ in Manila, develops, builds and operates quality, branded, affordable hotels throughout Southeast Asia. Roxaco Land is the property arm of Roxas and Company Incorporated. A publicly listed firm which owns Roxas Holdings and whilst owning a land bank of several thousand hectares, is also the largest producer and second largest refiner of sugar in the Philippines. Under the management of Vanguard Hotels Pte. Ltd., the joint venture has laid the foundation for the initial development of five “Go Hotels” brand within the Philippines. Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) is one of the leading real estate companies and is involved in the development of the mixed use properties, office buildings, land residential condominiums and housing developments. RLC also operates shopping malls and hotels and is the owner of the “Go Hotels” brand. For more information and updates, visit www.gohotels.ph or Go Hotels’ Facebook page.
